  (cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or pwsh.exe) that launches PowerShell with an encoded
  command (-enc) and obfuscation flags. This pattern is typical of remote service
  execution (T1569.002) where attackers use service creation or manipulation to execute
  payloads.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-20'
tags:
- attack.t1569.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    ParentImage|endswith:
    - services.exe
    Image|endswith:
    - cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - powershell
    - -enc
  selection2_1:
    ParentImage|endswith:
    - services.exe
    Image|endswith:
    - powershell.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -enc
  selection2_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -nop
    - -sta
    - -w
    - -windowstyle
  selection3:
    ParentImage|endswith:
    - services.exe
    Image|endswith:
    - pwsh.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -enc
  condition: (selection1 or all of selection2_* or selection3)
falsepositives:
- Legitimate software deployment tools that use service execution with encoded PowerShell
  commands (rare)
level: high
